title: Auto spawner seller for FyreSMP
description: This mod automatically sells items from your spawners on fyresmp. To make it work have your camera point at the spawner ( has to be in range ) and hit F9 on your keyboard. The mod will automatically find the sell button and press it every 30 seconds.
body:
This mod automatically sells items from your spawners on fyresmp. To make it work have your camera point at the spawner ( has to be in range ) and hit F9 on your keyboard. The mod will automatically find the sell button and press it every 30 seconds. It IS a macro, but its not really flaggable by the anticheat. Before running the mod ensure you have  Pause on lost focus disabled, just press F3 and P at the same time to disable/enable it. If you for some reason need the source code DM me to get my discord. HAVE FUN! Will update it if and when i feel like it
